# Fuzzy

> Security fuzzing and Verafy Certification for Solana programs. Agents use it to decide which Solana programs to trust.

Before calling an unfamiliar Solana program, check its Verafy Certification:

GET https://fuzzy.verafy.ai/api/certification?program=<program address>

Response fields: certified (true only for level 1 or more, past the ruling's challenge window), level (0 Not certified, 1 Sniffed, 2 Fuzzed, 3 Hardened), levelName, score, seats, families, ruling, reportHash, bytecodeHash, certificationAddress, reason.

A certification covers one exact build. An upgraded program reads as uncertified until it is certified again. Not certified means not vouched for, not malicious. A certification is not an audit.

Certifications are on Solana devnet today, program 1dcJPW3aGMCWDkNV6do6sEUwSxLdf8NtSuQb1teCdXt, account ["cert", program, sha256(bytecode)].

- [Verafy Certification](https://fuzzy.verafy.ai/certifications)
- [How Fuzzy scores a program](https://fuzzy.verafy.ai/method)
- [Source and charter](https://github.com/Verafyai/fuzzy)
